description: central/published.json of the published folder: what it holds and how fresh it is. Written by the publish step of meterline-job; central only. Generated from meterline_job/schemas.py; do not edit by hand.

data_complete_through.description: the earliest complete_through of the configured connectors; null when one has none

forced_freezes.description: frozen months whose sources were not all final: the cap forced them

frozen_months.description: months delivered once and never changed

in_progress_months.description: months of the latest build that are refreshed on every run

key_rotations.description: frozen months whose hashing key differs from the latest build's: manager and person folders do not show them

latest_build.description: the name of the build the in-progress months come from (builds/<name>)

policy_sha256.description: per source build (the latest and each frozen month's), the hash of the policy it was made with

sources.description: one entry per configured source (connector), in the order of the job file

complete_through.description: the last day the connector holds as final, as it returns it; null when it has none or could not say

failure_kind.description: this run's failure kind of the step; null when the step did not run in this invocation

anyOf.description: a UTC instant, ISO 8601 with the +00:00 offset

last_ok_run.description: the UTC time of the newest published manifest in the source's data folder; null when none

name.description: the connector's name in the job file

step_ok.description: whether this run's connector step succeeded; null when the step did not run in this invocation

warnings.description: forced_freeze YYYY-MM, policy_changed YYYY-MM, stale_source NAME and complete_through_unavailable NAME of this publish

title: published.json
